run_collect_shortest_path_data: run the script to collect shortest path navigation data from HM3D or Gibson scene datasets
run_parse_args: run parse_args to configure dataset type, sample count, split, and worker count for data collection
run_get_scenes: run get_scenes to discover and list all scene GLB files from HM3D and Gibson datasets
run_make_cfg: run make_cfg to create a Habitat-Sim simulator configuration with RGB camera and agent action space
run_sample_random_path: run sample_random_path to find a valid shortest path between two random navigable points in a scene
